frequency_question: What proportion of bilateral water treaty renewals involving joint technical committees and cabinet ratifications are successfully signed within a 12-month window prior to expiration?
membership_rule: Includes any bilateral transboundary water treaty involving joint river commissions where a renewal or successor framework was negotiated and signed. Excludes unilateral declarations or treaties abandoned entirely without replacement.

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 6 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 6 named cases covering major bilateral water treaty renewals; represents standard practice for cooperative transboundary treaty successions.
known_gaps: Excludes minor local municipal water pacts; focuses on national-level treaties.
skeleton: 6 historical bilateral water treaty renewals/successor negotiations examined; 6 successfully executed within the target timeframe of active administrative scheduling.
validity_reason: Bilateral diplomatic negotiation protocols and joint river commission procedures change slowly over decades.
